body: American Airlines has resumed flights to Haiti, launching daily nonstop service between Miami International Airport and Cap-Haitien International Airport (CAP) on November 1. The airline is the first major US network carrier to restore service to the country since US airlines suspended flights amid escalating security concerns in 2024. Its inaugural flight carried an all-Haitian, Creole-speaking crew led by Captain Oliver Jean.

The service does not extend to Port-au-Prince, where the Federal Aviation Administration continues to restrict US commercial operators because of security threats, including armed attacks on aircraft. Cap-Haitien, in northern Haiti, falls outside the restricted area around the capital, and American previously operated Miami-Cap-Haitien service between 2014 and 2020, although it had not flown to Cap-Haitien for more than six years before this launch. The airline is operating the route with Boeing 737 aircraft and described Cap-Haitien as its 100th destination in the Caribbean and Latin America network, with more than 90 onward connections through Miami. In November 2024, gunfire struck aircraft operated by American, JetBlue and Spirit near Port-au-Prince, prompting US carriers to suspend service.
en.summary: American Airlines has resumed service to Haiti with daily Miami-Cap-Haitien flights from November 1, becoming the first major US network carrier to return since the 2024 suspension, while Port-au-Prince remains restricted.
en.title: American Airlines returns to Haiti with daily Miami-Cap-Haitien service

body: 美國航空恢復飛往海地的航班，11月1日起開通邁阿密國際機場與海地角國際機場之間的每日直飛航線。美國航空是自2024年美國航空公司因安全疑慮停飛以來，首家恢復飛往海地服務的大型美國網絡航空公司。首航機組為全海地籍、能說克里奧爾語的機組，由奧利弗讓機長帶隊。

這項服務並未延伸至太子港，美國聯邦航空總署因安全威脅，包括針對飛機的武裝攻擊，仍限制美國商業業者飛往海地首都。海地角位於海地北部，落在首都周邊限制區域之外，美國航空曾於2014年至2020年間營運邁阿密至海地角航線，但在本次開航前已有6年多未飛往海地角。美國航空以波音737執飛這條航線，並稱海地角是其加勒比海與拉丁美洲網絡的第100個航點，經邁阿密可轉接90多個後續航點。2024年11月，美國航空、捷藍航空與精神航空的飛機在太子港附近遭到槍擊，促使美國業者停飛。
zh.summary: 美國航空11月1日起恢復飛往海地服務，開通邁阿密至海地角每日航線，成為2024年停飛以來首家返回海地的大型美國網絡航空公司，但太子港仍受限制。
zh.title: 美國航空重返海地，開通邁阿密至海地角每日航線
